selection.readout: Z marginals; normalized independent-bit categorical word probabilities
selection.graph: training-only count graph, 24-neighbor threshold, symmetric normalization
selection.input: square roots of normalized recency counts, decay 0.7, eight past words
selection.rule: Fixed evolution time minimizes no-ansatz validation NLL on the declared grid. Identical fixed Hamiltonian encoder in both Hamiltonian arms. Same 16-layer forward RX/RZ/CRZ circuit, categorical training loss, initialization seeds, optimizer and regularization as saved causal QCSE baseline. Checkpoints selected by validation NLL; no test-based choices. No unigram mixture or learned readout in any arm.
selection.scope: Follow-up requested after the primary study; not an independent fresh test set.
